thread.title: Google Outsold Amazon In Smart Home Devices Worldwide In Early 2018

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: Google Outsold Amazon In Smart Home Devices Worldwide In Early 2018
text:
Voice-activated smart home speakers from Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google outsold those of Amazon.com ( AMZN ) worldwide for the first time during 2018's first quarter, a market researcher said Wednesday.
X Alphabet's Google sold 3.2 million Home and Home Mini devices, accounting for 36.2% of worldwide sales, vs. Amazon's 2.5 million sales of its popular Echo devices, research firm Canalys said in its report . The devices use artificial intelligence software for internet search and entertainment features.
China's Alibaba Group Holding ( BABA ) and Xiaomi accounted for 11.8% and 7% of worldwide sales of smart home speakers, said Canalys.
Google has been pricing its Home and Home Mini smart speaker systems aggressively.

CIRP says that at the end of 2017 Amazon had 69% of the U.S. market, with 31 million Echo devices sold overall. Google had 31% with 14 million units sold.
Apple ( AAPL ) introduced its Siri-assisted HomePod devices in February. Canalys didn't disclose sales for Apple's HomePod devices.
Shares of Alphabet were up 1% to 1,085.96 on the stock market today, while Amazon added 1.3% to 1,601.86.
